Class RemoveCrewState

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.client.model.state.GameState
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.client.model.state.AdventureState
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.client.model.state.RemoveCrewState
All Implemented Interfaces:
AdventureStateInterface, GameStateInterface
public final class RemoveCrewState extends AdventureState implements GameStateInterface, AdventureStateInterface
Represents the state where players must remove crew members in the Galaxy Truckers game. This state is triggered when a ship encounters a situation that requires crew sacrifice, such as the slavers card. The player must choose which crew members to remove from their ship.
